rows.recommendation: Validate 0 < STOP_LOSS_PCT < 100 at load and fail loud; compare against a real price (card EXIT-02).
rows.name: Fixed stop-loss percent (active below 2x, before trailing activates)
rows.comparison: currentPrice <= entryPrice * (1 - stopLossPct / 100) while trailingActivated is false; currentPrice and entryPrice are probe outputs (AUD-EXIT-003)
rows.units: percent below the entry probe output
rows.effective_non_numeric: 25 (isNaN guard); but 0, negative and >= 100 are accepted: 0 sells at the first tick at or below entry, negative sells at once, >= 100 never sells
rows.rationale: none in code (marked @deprecated next to the legacy fields but still used by the exit engine)
rows.overlap: disabled once trailing activates at 2x (:1781); the urgency exit (TH-EXIT-08) is the only other routine exit

rows.recommendation: Guard NaN and validate min <= base <= max at load (fail loud).
rows.name: Trailing stop base percent (pullback from the high-water mark, active at >= 2x)
rows.comparison: currentPrice <= highWaterMark * (1 - effectivePct / 100), effectivePct = clamp(base * volatilityMult * urgencyMult, min, max)
rows.effective_non_numeric: NaN: effectivePct is NaN and the trailing stop never fires (AUD-EXIT-016)
rows.overlap: combines with TH-EXIT-03/04 (clamp), TH-EXIT-08 (urgency tightens) and TH-EXIT-09 (volatility widens)

rows.recommendation: Guard NaN and require min <= max.
rows.name: Trailing stop minimum percent after adjustment
rows.comparison: Math.max(minPct, Math.min(maxPct, adjusted))
rows.effective_non_numeric: NaN: Math.max(NaN, x) is NaN, so the trailing stop never fires
rows.overlap: with the urgency multiplier going to 0, effectivePct converges to this minimum near the 30-minute deadline

rows.recommendation: Guard NaN and require max < 100 and >= min.
rows.name: Trailing stop maximum percent after adjustment
rows.comparison: Math.min(maxPct, adjusted)
rows.effective_non_numeric: NaN: the clamp yields NaN, so the trailing stop never fires
rows.overlap: caps the volatility widening (TH-EXIT-09)

rows.recommendation: Keep the number; base it on a real price (card EXIT-02).
rows.name: Trailing stop activation multiple
rows.comparison: priceMultiple >= 2.0 sets trailingActivated (permanent for the position; it also turns stop-loss off)
rows.units: ratio of probe outputs (not a price ratio, AUD-EXIT-003)
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a; an Infinity multiple (entry price 0) activates it on the first tick
rows.overlap: with partial tiers at the same multiple both act on one tick (the full-exit check runs first, :1817-1826)

rows.recommendation: Require multiples > 1 at load; base tiers on a real price (card EXIT-02).
rows.name: Partial sell tiers
rows.comparison: priceMultiple >= tier.multiple for each unfilled tier; amount = originalTokenAmount * sum(percent) / 100 (bigint)
rows.units: multiple of the entry probe output : percent of the ORIGINAL token amount
rows.representation: string "2x:50,5x:25" parsed to floats and ints, sorted by multiple
rows.effective_non_numeric: throws at module load (exitConfig is built at import, :126), so the bot does not start: fail loud. A multiple below 1 (e.g. 0.5x) is accepted and sells that tier at the first tick; percent is parseInt, so 33.9 becomes 33
rows.overlap: Infinity multiple (entry 0) fires every tier at once (AUD-EXIT-003 sub-claim 4)

rows.recommendation: Self-rescheduling timer or skip-if-running, plus a quote timeout below the interval (card EXIT-04).
rows.name: Exit poll interval per position
rows.comparison: setInterval cadence; overrun telemetry durationMs > pollIntervalMs (:1924)
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.overlap: a cycle slower than 5 s overlaps the next (no in-flight guard, AUD-EXIT-005); the quote has no timeout (ethers FetchRequest default 300000 ms), so up to about 60 cycles can stack

rows.recommendation: Let the urgency exit fire even when the price quote is null (card EXIT-02).
rows.name: Urgency window (hard market exit deadline)
rows.comparison: urgencyMult = 1 - age/window (linear); urgencyMult <= 0 enqueues urgency-market-sell; it also shrinks the trailing percent toward the minimum
rows.units: milliseconds since urgencyStartTs (set at monitor start, persisted, never updated on upsert)
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.overlap: skipped entirely on a null quote (:1709-1712), so it is not a guaranteed backstop; after a restart later than 30 minutes every resumed position exits on its first good tick

rows.name: Volatility tracker parameters (baseline CV, max samples, min samples)
rows.current_value: baseline CV 0.03, max 60 samples (5 min at 5 s), min 12 samples (1 min)
rows.comparison: multiplier = max(1, (stddev/mean) / 0.03) once >= 12 samples; widens the trailing percent before the clamp
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.overlap: samples are probe outputs; stacked overlapping cycles add extra samples (AUD-EXIT-005)

rows.recommendation: Cap at a small value (for example 100 bps) at load and fail loud above it.
rows.name: Dust threshold for "position closed"
rows.current_value: 1 bps of the original token amount, with an absolute floor of 1000 base units
rows.comparison: balanceOf <= max(original * bps / 10000, 1000) means a genuine close (teardown); above means still held
rows.units: basis points of original_token_amount; token base units
rows.effective_non_numeric: 1 (parseInt, NaN or negative falls back); '1.9' gives 1; no upper bound: 10000 or more makes any balance up to the original count as closed
rows.overlap: when exit_state is missing (original 0) only the 1000-unit floor applies, which fails safe toward held

rows.recommendation: Require >= 1; exempt operator sells from the pause (card EXIT-07).
rows.name: Consecutive routine exit failures before routine retries pause
rows.comparison: reason !== 'anti-rug' && exit_failure_count >= max -> pause (in-memory Set)
rows.effective_non_numeric: 5; 0 is accepted (pause after the first failure)
rows.overlap: the pause also blocks the dashboard force/emergency sells (AUD-EXIT-008); the in-memory pause is lost on restart while the persisted count is kept

rows.recommendation: Keep attempts * confirm window below the watchdog budget, or derive one from the other (card EXIT-11).
rows.name: Private sell attempts before the public fallback
rows.comparison: attempts passed to escalatePrivateSell and to the sell reconcile config
rows.effective_non_numeric: 2; 0 is accepted and means no private attempt (straight to public, txManager.ts:100 comment)
rows.rationale: D-FALLBACK-TRIGGER (comment): a rug is happening now, so anti-rug burns one quick attempt
rows.overlap: each attempt holds the wallet nonce lock for its confirm window (TH-EXIT-22), so 2 attempts can exceed the 60 s watchdog (TH-EXIT-21)

rows.recommendation: Re-quote right before the swap (card EXIT-09).
rows.name: Routine public-fallback slippage
rows.comparison: minOut = expectedOut * (100 - slippage) / 100 from a quote taken before the approve wait (AUD-EXIT-011)
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.rationale: D-FALLBACK-NO-DOUBLE-SELL (comment): reuse the configured exit slippage
rows.overlap: shared with the buy slippage (TH-BUY-02)

rows.name: Anti-rug public-fallback slippage
rows.comparison: max(antiRug, 10, routine)
rows.effective_non_numeric: 15; values above 99 are clamped to 99 by TH-EXIT-15
rows.rationale: T-21.2-SANDWICH (comment): a sandwiched sell beats a stranded position; 10 % floor from recover-sell-ladys.ts
rows.overlap: only used when the anti-rug private attempt did not land

rows.name: Public minOut clamp
rows.current_value: effective slippage clamped to [0, 99] %, keep at least 1 %
rows.comparison: keepPct = max(1, round(100 - clamp(slippage, 0, 99))); minOut = expectedOut * keepPct / 100
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.rationale: IN-03 (comment): never a zero floor on a public sell
rows.overlap: applies to the public fallback only; private sells have no floor (TH-EXIT-16)

rows.recommendation: Decide on card OD-14.
rows.name: Private sell minimum output
rows.comparison: none: any output is accepted
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.rationale: none in code; private routing is the implied protection
rows.overlap: used by full and partial private sells on every chain, including passthrough chains

rows.name: Private sell deadline
rows.current_value: now + 60 s, computed each time the builder runs
rows.comparison: router deadline check on chain
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.overlap: shorter than one 45 s confirm window plus polling only if the builder is not re-run per attempt (it is re-run, since the builder is a closure)

rows.recommendation: Re-quote after the approve (card EXIT-09).
rows.name: Public fallback deadline
rows.current_value: now + 600 s, computed after the approve wait
rows.comparison: router deadline check on chain
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.overlap: the minOut it carries comes from a quote taken before the approve wait (TH-EXIT-13)

rows.name: Sell gas limit
rows.current_value: chain maxGasLimit: ETH 300000, BSC 500000, Base 500000, Arbitrum 1000000
rows.comparison: fixed gasLimit on the private sell tx; also the gas input to the sell reconcile config
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.overlap: approvals and the public fallback use ethers estimateGas instead

rows.recommendation: Apply the anti-rug fee policy to the approve and the public fallback too, under a ceiling (card EXIT-03).
rows.name: Anti-rug gas multiplier
rows.comparison: multiplies the private-leg fee fields when reason is anti-rug; not applied to approvals or the public fallback
rows.effective_empty: 0 (Number('')), which is < 1.0, so boot exits (fail loud)
rows.effective_non_numeric: NaN, so boot exits (fail loud); 'Infinity' passes the check
rows.overlap: not applied on the public fallback, which is the guaranteed lever

rows.recommendation: Derive the budget from attempts * confirm window, and release the sell lock when an exit is abandoned (cards EXIT-11, EXIT-04).
rows.name: Exit watchdog budget (worker submits and the direct anti-rug exit)
rows.comparison: Promise.race(submit, timer); on overrun the caller is freed and the exit counted as failed; the submit keeps running and keeps its locks
rows.effective_non_numeric: 60000; '1.5e3' parses as 1
rows.rationale: .env.example: must exceed one 45 s confirm window plus margin
rows.overlap: shorter than 2 routine private attempts * 45 s plus reconcile plus public fallback, so a normal routine exit can overrun it; an anti-rug exit waiting on the nonce lock can overrun it before it signs (AUD-EXIT-014). Same knob as TH-BUY-14 (22-28 merges)

rows.recommendation: See TH-EXIT-12 / TH-EXIT-21.
rows.name: Sell-leg confirm window and poll
rows.comparison: reconcileInclusion polls receipt and nonce until the window ends
rows.overlap: also used per private attempt inside escalatePrivateSell (TX slice) while the nonce lock is held; owned by the TX slice, recorded here for its exit timing effect

rows.recommendation: Wire the leg through to the strategies so this ceiling applies to private sells (card TX-02, AUD-TX-010), and apply a sell ceiling to approvals and the public fallback (card EXIT-03).
rows.name: Sell-leg priority fee ceiling
rows.current_value: 25 gwei (no effect on any private sell: the strategies call buildReconcileConfig with no leg, so private sells use the buy ceiling MEV_BUY_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI; AUD-TX-010)
rows.comparison: would cap the escalated priority fee of private sells, but the leg argument never reaches the strategies (flashbots.ts:182, bloxroute.ts:104, passthrough.ts:83); only the no-double-sell guard config at exitEngine.ts:940 reads it, and that config uses only the confirm window and poll, so this ceiling caps nothing today
rows.overlap: does not cap private sells (AUD-TX-010) and does not cover approvals or the public fallback swap (AUD-EXIT-004); the TX slice owns the escalation (TH-TX-04)

rows.recommendation: Card EXIT-02.
rows.name: Price probe amount
rows.current_value: parseEther(buy amount) at start (snipe amount, or the deliberate amount); parseEther(current snipe amount) on resume and re-arm
rows.comparison: used as the token amountIn of the quote; priceMultiple = output / entry output
rows.units: native-coin wei reused as raw token units (AUD-EXIT-003)
rows.effective_non_numeric: parseEther throws, so startExitMonitor rejects (AUD-EXIT-002 sibling)
rows.overlap: not persisted with the entry price, so resume and re-arm compare different probes (AUD-EXIT-015)

rows.name: Exit worker priority ranks
rows.current_value: anti-rug 0 (reserved, unused), urgency 1, stop-loss 1, trailing 2, other 3
rows.comparison: ascending rank, FIFO within a rank
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.overlap: anti-rug and partial sells do not go through the queue, so they never pre-empt it (AUD-EXIT-014)

rows.recommendation: Price the reserve with the same fee rule the fallback actually uses (card EXIT-03).
rows.name: Exit-reserve base-fee multiplier in the buy-time affordability gate
rows.comparison: worstCasePublicSellGas = (maxGasLimit + approvalGas) * baseFee * buffer, reserved before a buy
rows.overlap: not read by the EXIT slice; the real public fallback uses ethers default fees (2 * baseFee + node priority fee, no ceiling), so the reserve can be smaller than the real cost in a gas spike

rows.recommendation: Card EXIT-03.
rows.name: Approval amount
rows.comparison: currentAllowance < amount -> approve(amount)
rows.effective_non_numeric: n/a
rows.overlap: each first exit of a position needs a public, unbounded-wait approve first (AUD-EXIT-004, AUD-EXIT-009)
